title: Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications, features & price in India of iPhone Duo
content: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at Rs 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23.

title: Pegula vs Navarro: The $15 billion 'battle' that dwarfed Djokovic, Federer and Nadal's wealth
content: Jessica Pegula staged a stunning comeback in her US Open quarter-final against Emma Navarro after losing the first set. Securing victory, Pegula progresses to the semi-finals for the third consecutive year, showcasing her resilience on the court. Meanwhile, Navarro's impressive journey to the quarter-finals hints at a bright future in tennis, with both athletes coming from families boasting a combined net worth of fifteen billion dollars.

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launched: Price in India and all details

Pre-orders kick off on September 12, with global availability beginning on September 18. In India, the Pro model will start at Rs 1,64,900.

title: 3 trucks of debris, 1 missing wall: How renovation doomed Delhi PG building

A labour contractor was arrested and stated Mahesh Gupta paid him daily for the work.  The building's paying guest operator was also arrested for negligence.  Seven people died after the five-storey building collapsed on September 6.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks

title: Apple increases prices of iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air & iPhone 16
content: With the unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple has raised prices for its devices in India. The iPhone 17e and iPhone 16 are also affected by substantial price increases. The iPhone 17 now retails for Rs 99,900, marked up by Rs 17,000, whereas the premium iPhone Air skyrocketed by Rs 30,000. Highlights of the new iPhone 17 encompass a 120Hz display and upgraded 48MP cameras.

title: Over 10 feared trapped as under-construction building collapses in Gandhinagar
content: An under-construction building collapsed in Gandhinagar's Kudasan area on Wednesday. Fire department teams immediately launched rescue operations at the affected construction site. This incident follows a recent building collapse in Delhi which tragically killed seven people. Authorities are continuing their rescue efforts in Gandhinagar while awaiting further details. The event has renewed scrutiny of building safety and construction practices nationwide.

title: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump’s wealth: How did they build their business empires?
content: Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.

title: Stephen and Ayesha Curry’s parenting: How did they teach kids to handle criticism?
content: Stephen and Ayesha Curry prioritize instilling self-confidence in their children amidst the spotlight. They encourage their kids to embrace their individuality, even in the face of scrutiny. Ayesha spoke out to protect Riley's experiences with early fame, while also addressing unwanted comments about Canon's weight. Their mission is clear: to empower their children to wear the Curry name proudly and securely.

title: Wall Street falls as crude tops $101; Dow tumbles over 300 points
content: Oil prices have soared past the $100 mark per barrel, resulting in a dip in Wall Street's performance. This increase has amplified worries over fuel costs and inflation for both consumers and businesses alike. With petrol prices showing a 32% increase compared to last year, household finances are feeling the strain.

title: He scored 99th percentile in CAT but chose Army; meet Col Anurag Upadhyay
content: Colonel Anurag Upadhyay, a former Indian Army Special Forces officer, is seeking expert medical and technological support after suffering a severe stroke in August 2025 that resulted in locked-in syndrome and bilateral below-knee amputations. Despite remaining conscious and communicating through eye movements, his family is exploring advanced rehabilitation, neurological research and assistive technologies such as brain-computer interfaces and eye-tracking systems. A public appeal seeks credible specialists, institutions and organisations that could help identify further possibilities for recovery and independence.

title: ‘Wanted to teach him lesson’: Delhi accused on assault that killed Manipuri musician
content: Seven men and a juvenile were arrested for the alleged killing of Chongtham Vikram Singh.  The accused reportedly assaulted the musician after he objected to noise outside his home.  Singh, a musician, died hours after the assault due to internal injuries.  Police are investigating all aspects, including a potential racial angle in the incident.  The North Eastern Students' Organisation demanded a swift and impartial probe into the matter.

title: Watch: Ferry erupts in flames off Philippines’ Palawan; 5 killed
content: Tragedy struck as the M/V June Aster passenger ferry ignited flames near Coron, Palawan, claiming at least five lives, as confirmed by officials. The Philippine Coast Guard swiftly initiated rescue missions, successfully saving 42 individuals from the inferno. The ill-fated ferry had embarked on its journey from Manila, carrying numerous passengers and crew members.

title: Belgium sinks 23 giant concrete blocks to build world's first energy island
content: Belgium is constructing the world's first artificial energy island in the North Sea. This massive structure will collect electricity from offshore wind farms and transmit it ashore. The island's design incorporates nature-inclusive elements to support marine life and bird species. While civil engineering nears completion, electrical infrastructure installation will continue until 2030. The project aims to become operational around 2030, enhancing European electricity exchange.

title: Jeremy Corbyn finds buyer for £700,000 London home after 19 years
content: Jeremy Corbyn has found a buyer for his three-bedroom Finsbury Park home after 19 years. The former Labour leader bought the North London property for £363,000 in 2007 and initially listed it for £800,000 this year. The house was later reduced to offers over £700,000 and is now under offer, according to reports.

title: ‘Pilot is a good leader’: Channi backs new Punjab Congress in-charge

title: CIA chief Ratcliffe may take bigger role in stalled Russia-Ukraine talks

title: Nepal’s flood bill could hit $5 billion. Where will the money come from?

title: Goods train derails in J&K’s Kathua, no injury or damages
content:
Kathua, J&K (ANI photo)

JAMMU: A goods train derailed at Chann Aroria railway station in J&K’s Kathua district on Wednesday morning. Officials said no one was hurt and no damage was incurred in the incident. The derailment occurred around 9.30am when the goods train was heading back after unloading cement, and one of its coaches went off the track in the station’s yard, officials said. A technical team from Kathua rushed to the spot and brought the derailed coach back on track after two hours of efforts. Earlier on July 10, two bogies of a goods train moving from Jammu to Punjab derailed near Lakhanpur in Kathua after debris fell on the tracks following a rain-triggered landslide.
